name: hud_ui_triplet_panel_set_visible_count
description: HudUiTripletPanel::SetVisibleCount clamps the requested visible item count, forwards visibility to the three child items, and invalidates the panel when the count changes.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native triplet-panel visibility tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40f460 validates the unchanged-count early return, clamp to the 0..4 range, visibleCount write, child SetVisible dispatch for the first three items, and final panel invalidation.
The native triplet-panel smoke verifies two visible children, negative-count clamping to zero, unchanged-count early return, and the HudUiMgr::SetNanitePanelCount forwarding path.
